messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] fitmargBMA2
parts:
Hi,

fitmargBMA2 is a function to merge inlay objects. You can use inla.merge (implemented in the R-INLA package) on a list of inla objects to obtain an averaged inla object. This should be preferred now.

Best,

Virgilio
